notes: Danish professional brand (ernitec.com). No official Ernitec documentation publishes a fixed RTSP URL/stream path. The Ernitec Hawk SX / SX Series / Orion SX user manuals, the EVA-series (EVA 101/201) manuals, the MicroView MVIB-01IR-E manual, and the 2018 generic 'Ernitec Network Camera' user manual only list RTSP as a *supported protocol* (IPv4/v6, TCP, UDP, RTP, RTSP, HTTP, HTTPS, ONVIF, ...) and expose a configurable 'RTSP port' plus a 'Streaming > Video Format' config menu (H.264 + MJPEG / H.264 + H.264 multi-stream); none specify a fixed RTSP path such as /cam1/h264. Cameras are accessed via web UI, the DeviceSearch/IPAdminTool utility, or ONVIF. All lead paths (cam[CHANNEL]/h264, h264, h264_2/3/4, mpeg4, jpeg) originate from crowd-sourced aggregators (iSpyConnect/Agent DVR, smartvision.dev, camlytics) that explicitly disclaim their data; iSpyConnect maps /cam[CHANNEL]/h264 to Hawk/Mercury/Orion/Vega and /h264,/h264_2..4,/mpeg4,/jpeg to model SX302IR, but this is not Ernitec's own documentation. Ernitec's own PDF hosts (files.ernitec.com, files.eetgroup.com) were unreachable at verification time (persistent connection timeouts), so the PDFs could not be directly parsed; readable ManualsLib mirrors of the same manuals were checked and contain no fixed RTSP path. Per the CC0 no-guessing rule, no template is published. To integrate, use ONVIF auto-discovery or read the exact RTSP URL from the camera's own web UI.
